name: Ethplorer API (api.ethplorer.io)
tier_rationale: Ethplorer, a long-running token explorer with an identifiable operator, public API documentation and a multi-year track record (A8 community). Tiers: Etherscan, OKLink, PublicNode trusted; Blockscout, Ethplorer community.

reliability.justification: Token explorer: ETH balance, token holdings with prices and contract creator in one call; prices are market data of the provider.

error_markers.reason: Ethplorer: error object in the answer (invalid key, address or request): could not verify

ethplorer.description: Ethplorer API key of the team (never the shared public 'freekey' test key)
ethplorer.plan_hint: business = the team's own Ethplorer key on a plan whose terms allow company use (P212 cond 1)

terms.quote: Per-adapter classes (A1 BR3): Blockscout keyless and PublicNode RPC 'open' (free public APIs, terms recorded, as in P205 and P211); Etherscan, Ethplorer and OKLink 'key-terms' (company keys on recorded plans).

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P212 cond 5). 'Ethplorer only with the team's own key 'ethplorer', never the shared 'freekey' test key' (P212 cond 1): evm_explorers refuses the value 'freekey' even when configured. Research C0485: errors as {'error': {'code', 'message'}}; the key travels as apiKey= (camelCase; AR01 redaction is case-insensitive for key-like parameters). Used by evm_explorers.
